Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - MediCorps

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, happy to kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SIG) for MediCorps. Quick recap on a few items you asked about and the next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary (quick answers)
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and is currently running Type II readiness; Type II expected completion in Q3 2026. I attached our latest SOC 2 summary.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA-covered workloads (BAA available) and are able to sign GDPR-compliant data processing addenda.
- Data residency: Hosted regions in us-west and eu-west are available; we can discuss a private deployment for strict residency needs.
- Encryption: Data encrypted at rest and in transit. Customer keys supported via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS).

Requested next steps
1) Please share the SIG questionnaire (or a link). If you prefer, we can prefill common fields and return a CSV to speed review.
2) Dylan (cc'd) will review technical controls and provide detailed answers for network and infra controls.
3) I’ll follow up with SOC 2 evidence where available — see attached summary and network diagram.

Would you like us to start by filling the SIG spreadsheet or upload answers directly to your vendor portal? We can deliver an initial draft within 3 business days once we have the questionnaire.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - MediCorps

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick recap. A few clarifying questions before we send the SIG: 

1) SOC 2: Can you confirm the date range for the Type II when completed (start/end)? Is the scope limited to hosted API or does it include Dedicated/Private deployments?
2) BAA: Do you have a standard BAA template we can review? Any additional costs or contract terms for HIPAA-covered data?
3) Subprocessors: Can you provide a list of subprocessors and whether any have access to plaintext customer data?
4) Logging & Audit: Are access logs retained for at least 12 months and available for export?
5) Encryption/KMS: If we require customer-managed keys, does Redwood support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for both Hosted and Dedicated modes?
6) Evidence transfer: Do you prefer attaching evidence to the SIG or sharing via a secure link/share with expiring URLs?

We use the SIG spreadsheet (CSV) in our procurement process — I’ll attach the form to a follow-up email, but if you can prefill the high-level fields that speeds our review. Also loop in any security SME who should own the technical responses.

Appreciate it — we’re on a 2-week procurement timeline for initial vendor selection.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Security, MediCorps
laura.chen@medicorps.com | +1 617-555-0104
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - MediCorps

Laura — thanks for the questions, and great to have the timeline. Answers inline and next actions below.

On 2/12/26 at 1:20 PM, Laura Chen wrote:
> 1) SOC 2: Can you confirm the date range for the Type II when completed (start/end)? Is the scope limited to hosted API or does it include Dedicated/Private deployments?

- SOC 2 Type II: expected test period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-07-31; report issuance expected by 2026-08-15. Current Type I report and control matrix attached. Scope covers our Hosted API and our core orchestration/control plane; Dedicated and Private deployments are included only for control areas that Redwood operates (e.g., control plane, deployment tooling). For on-prem/private deployments where the customer manages infrastructure, certain infrastructure controls will be out-of-scope — happy to map scope to your deployment model.

> 2) BAA: Do you have a standard BAA template we can review? Any additional costs or contract terms for HIPAA-covered data?

- We have a standard BAA; no additional platform cost for HIPAA support beyond our standard pricing. I’ll attach the template in a follow-up.

> 3) Subprocessors: Can you provide a list of subprocessors and whether any have access to plaintext customer data?

- Subprocessor list attached (high level). No subprocessors have access to plaintext customer content by default. Where access is required for debugging, access is tightly controlled and logged; we can provide evidence on request.

> 4) Logging & Audit: Are access logs retained for at least 12 months and available for export?

- Yes, audit logs retained for 13 months by default; exports available via console/BI extract or on-request export.

> 5) Encryption/KMS: If we require customer-managed keys, does Redwood support BYOK for both Hosted and Dedicated modes?

- BYOK supported for Hosted (via customer KMS integration) and for Dedicated deployments. For Private/on-prem, we can integrate with your local KMS.

> 6) Evidence transfer: Do you prefer attaching evidence to the SIG or sharing via a secure link/share with expiring URLs?

- We prefer secure links with expiring access for larger evidence bundles; small PDFs can be attached to the SIG. We’ll provide secure SharePoint links for large evidence sets.

Next actions
- Dylan (cc'd) will own technical SIG responses. Dylan: can you confirm availability to pick up the SIG and target to return an initial prefill CSV in 3 business days?
- Laura/Procurement: if you can share the SIG CSV or a portal link, I’ll get Dylan started today.
- I will also share our BAA and the full subprocessor list by end of day.

Thanks — we’ll treat this as high priority to meet your 2-week timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
